Free, No Obligation Estimates! Residential Metal Roofing Types Installing a quality metal roof is one of the best investments you can make to boost your home’s value and performance. Choose our steel roofing company today to have our experienced contractors walk you through every step of the commercial roof installation or repair process. Learn More Metal Roofs Metal roofs are known for their superior durability and energy efficiency. The initial cost of a metal roof may be higher than other options, but its longevity and simple maintenance saves money in the long term. Commercial metal roofs can last up to 50 years. Metal roofs are one of the most environmentally friendly & sustainable roofing systems available. TPO Roofing TPO is a single-ply roofing system that is made of a blend of rubber and plastic materials. These roofs are durable, lightweight, and resistant to UV rays, punctures, and chemicals. Commercial TPO roofs can last up to 30 years. TPO is a popular choice for “green” building since it has very low degradation under UV radiation and no added plasticizers. Flat Roofs A flat roof is a roof that is almost level in contrast to the sloped roofs typically found on single family homes. The most common flat roof material types are Built-up Roof (BUR), Modified Bitumen (Mod-Bit), Concrete, TPO, EPDM, PVC & Metal. Flat roofs are the most popular roofing choice for commercial buildings. Modified Bitumen Roofs Modified Bitumen combines asphalt with rubber or plastic additives and is reinforced with fiberglass to create a sturdy yet flexible roofing material. This system is often roll-applied to the roof surface with heat or adhesive. Bitumen flat roofs can last up to 20 years. Modified Bitumen is not popular in discussion, but these roofs are still pretty common and have a good reputation. Lifetime Roofing Systems Text Learn More About Metal Roofing Specialists, Inc. reviews.text: Transitioned from shingles to metal and glad I did. Team was professional and very talented. Excellent!
reviews.author: Debie Bolin

reviews.text:
Bill, your guys did such an incredible job on my moms house. They were so sweet and professional. Her house looks amazing, and she is SO HAPPY.
I wanted to make you aware that they were so amazing to help my mom's neighbor with some branches the city refused to pick up for her. The woman is an older lady with no help and as she was trying to break down some larger limbs in her yard your crew saw her struggling and took the time to help her get it taken care of. Because of their generosity, the city came this morning and took the limbs away. I am so moved and impressed by their act of selflessness. I honestly wish there was something more I could do for you all... alas, my words of admiration and gratitude will have to suffice. Your professionalism and compassion go unmatched.
Thank you again for everything. We appreciate everything you've done.
reviews.author: Kasey Null
